Flashing Steel
games.comment:
I like the idea of a pirate brawl where there are weapons lying around that are picked up and used, but it's more suited to lego than it is tabletop miniatures.

The campaign creation rules in this are absolutely fantastic, and almost worth the price for that table alone.  It's essentially a 4d12 table rolled multiple times that made to craft a three-arc campaign romp for a night, and it is very well done!

games.name: Of Gods and Mortals: Mythological Wargame Rules
games.comment: Really fun!  Great theme, great gameplay, good advances over SBH's mechanics, which were already fantastic.  It seems as though it is designed to be played w/ more points than are granted by default in the book (so that more mortals are present as more than just batteries,) but I will find out soon.

games.name: Once Upon a Time: The Storytelling Card Game
The Resistance: Avalon
games.comment:
This has been my favorite game for several years now.  Although I miss bluffing that you're lying, there's something so pure and fun about the resistance that it has really stuck with me.

I can't recommend it to everyone.  I'm somewhat anti-confrontational in life, but I very much enjoy it in games -- if you don't enjoy it in games, don't touch this at all!
